name: 70053 · Gretna, LA
findings: ZIP 70053 (Gretna) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70053 (Gretna) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70053 (Gretna) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
